prose.title: The Thessalian Revolt
prose.summary: The four Thessalian cities of Larissa, Pharsalos, Pherai and Trikka break away and form the Thessalian League. It mostly happens when a new Antigonid faction leader comes to power while the Antigonid Kingdom holds all four cities, with a much higher chance from turn 76 (252 BC) or once the Antigonid Kingdom has shrunk to 14 settlements or fewer.
prose.breaks_away_from: The Antigonid Kingdom, or the rebels if they hold all four cities
prose.who_it_can_happen_to: Any campaign, whether the Antigonid Kingdom is played by a human or by the AI.
what_sets_it_off: Each time a new Antigonid faction leader comes to power, from turn 76 (252 BC) onwards, or earlier once the Antigonid Kingdom holds 14 settlements or fewer, there is a 25% chance of the revolt, provided the Antigonid Kingdom held Larissa, Pharsalos, Pherai and Trikka at the end of its last turn.

If that chance does not apply or fails, each new Antigonid faction leader brings a further 5% chance of the revolt at any point in the campaign, again only if the Antigonid Kingdom held all four cities at the end of its last turn.
If one of the four cities rebels while all four were in rebel hands at the end of the last Antigonid turn, there is a 50% chance of the revolt.
what_happens: Larissa, Pharsalos, Pherai and Trikka all rebel.
All four cities pass to the Thessalian League, which did not exist until now.

Each city gets a garrison at 0.01 times normal strength, drawn from Akontistai, Greek Slingers, Greek Archers, Thessalian Peltasts, Greek Hoplites, Thureophoroi, Prodromoi, Perrhaibian Cavalry, Xystophoroi and Thessalian Cavalry.
When Larissa revolts, the Thessalian League receives 10000 denarii.
The revolt happens only once per campaign.
prose.playing_as_the_rebels: Only a human playing the Antigonid Kingdom is offered the rebels, and only when the revolt comes from a change of faction leader. Once the revolt has happened, at the end of an Antigonid turn a message titled 'The Thessalian League Declares its Independence from Macedon!' offers to let you play as the Thessalian League. If you accept, you switch to playing the Thessalian League and a government building is placed in Larissa, Pharsalos, Pherai and Trikka.
